description: Cyclone Gezani (Toamasina, Madagascar) - Damage Assessment is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Microsoft AI for Good Lab. The portal files it under the publisher Microsoft AI for Good Lab. Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, facilities-infrastructure, geodata, natural disasters. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
